headline: Wall Street Closes Mixed as Nasdaq Gains While Dow Falls
summary: U.S. stocks closed mixed on Wednesday as the Nasdaq rose 0.42% and the Dow Jones fell 1.11%, driven by Nvidia's quarterly earnings and anticipation of the Anthropic IPO.
why: Major U.S. stock indices reflect investor sentiment across technology and traditional industrial sectors, serving as global benchmarks for risk appetite.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Positive momentum in technology stocks and strong corporate earnings lifted the tech-heavy index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong performance from major technology names like Nvidia and enthusiasm surrounding upcoming high-profile initial public offerings supported the tech sector while traditional industrial stocks lagged.
